blurb: Fine Art Gallery located in Provincetown, MA offering the most eclectic collection of fine contemporary art on cape cod includes sculpture, paintings, watercolors, photography, installation, assemblages, printmakers and etchings. Bowersock Gallery features exhibitions of professional, mid-career and emerging artists.
